name: Dal Dhokli
steps: Rinse toor dal and simmer with 1000 ml water and half the turmeric for 35–45 minutes until soft, then whisk smooth.
Mix wheat flour, gram flour, oil, remaining turmeric and 3 g salt. Add about 140 ml water gradually and knead a firm dough; cover for 20 minutes.
Heat ghee, pop mustard seeds and sizzle cumin. Add chopped tomato and chilli powder and cook for 6 minutes. Stir into the dal with jaggery, remaining salt and remaining measured water.
Roll dough thinly, about 2 mm, and cut into small diamonds. Bring dal to a gentle boil and add diamonds one at a time, stirring so they do not clump.
Simmer uncovered for 15–20 minutes, stirring gently, until dough pieces are tender with no raw flour centre. Add boiling water if the dal thickens too much.
Turn off heat, add lemon juice and coriander and serve immediately while loose and soupy.
tips: Rinse grains before cooking, use a heavy pan and rest covered before fluffing or serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
